# codebud

> A privacy-first, local coding agent that turns natural-language requests into executable plans using locally-running LLMs (Ollama + Qwen2.5-Coder). No API keys, no telemetry; by default no data leaves your machine.

## Core Resources

- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/mkhellat/codebud): Source code, documentation, and issue tracker.

## AI Agent & LLM Indexing

- Structured following the standard /llms.txt specification for AI search engines and coding assistants.
- Validated via [AccessGuard AI-Readiness Suite](https://ronanchnlps-bit.github.io/).
